title: Email/parse args
description: Arguments for Email/parse (RFC 8621 §5.5). Parses blobs as RFC 5322 messages without importing them.

accountId.description: The account whose blob store to parse from.

blobIds.description: Blob ids of the messages to parse.

properties.description: Email properties to return. Defaults to all properties.

fetchTextBodyValues.description: If true, include values for text/plain body parts.

fetchHTMLBodyValues.description: If true, include values for text/html body parts.

fetchAllBodyValues.description: If true, include values for all body parts.

maxBodyValueBytes.description: Truncate body values to this byte length.
